summary: Added signature-typed compiled Update effect decoding through the generated GoScript encoder. Declared effect slices are resolved from AppIR Update metadata and encoded for both Array and GoSlice results; untyped legacy Array results retain the existing strict validation path. Real compiled append removal, malformed wrapper/Effect/encoded Value, offset handling, cancellation and stale-reply cases pass.

focused_tests.warning: Node emitted the existing experimental EnvHttpProxyAgent warning.
Node emitted the existing experimental EnvHttpProxyAgent warning.

coverage: Compiled Update result type is discovered from AppIR symbol metadata; element fields must be exactly string Kind, Name, Arg, and Reply.
Generated encoder validates actual compiled GoScript Array and GoSlice effect outputs and returns the typed Value representation consumed by the existing effect policy and capability checks.
Real removeParent append effects are decoded in Go-emitted child-first order; only removed parent, child, and grandchild correlations are canceled, while the sibling remains live.
Malformed GoSlice metadata, malformed Go Effect own fields, malformed encoder Value fields, and nonzero slice offsets are covered.
A forced retired runtime completion is rejected, and direct stale Go complete messages leave remounted state unchanged.

limits: The Node lifecycle and shared-runtime suites are focused checks; full React/DOM/browser matrix evidence remains with the harness lane.
A separate reentrant unmount admission issue identified by XR-RUNTIME remains assigned to R-UNMOUNT and is not represented as fixed here.
